candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: All kanji, kana, readings, and index numbers match the image, including 〔人名〕 and 〔大学名〕 labels. Glosses are accurate. Only omissions: no English glosses supplied for 吉村和真 and 京都精華大 (the pipeline expected glosses on every entry). Blank lines between numbered groups are a harmless stylistic choice.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: All Japanese text, readings, and indices match the image exactly, including 〔人名〕 and 〔大学名〕 labels, which are additionally glossed as expected. Every entry has an accurate dictionary-style gloss. No errors detected.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Furigana error on first entry: （せっている）instead of （せってい）. Replaced 〔人名〕 with '[person name]' and dropped the 〔大学名〕 label entirely for 京都精華大, so the printed bracketed annotations are not faithfully reproduced. Glosses otherwise accurate.

rationale: B is the only candidate with perfect character accuracy, exact reproduction of the bracketed annotations 〔人名〕/〔大学名〕, and an accurate gloss on every entry, fully meeting the pipeline requirements. A matches B on Japanese fidelity but omits glosses on the two proper-noun entries, a small completeness gap. C has a genuine reading error (せっている for せってい) and fails to reproduce the printed bracket labels faithfully (translating one, dropping the other), placing it last.
